notes.title: Major update coming!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

with the latest steam review in mind, I am making a couple of changes to the game to improve it. In this current state and in my opinion, the game is average, with the changes the game will be alright/decent. I am increasing the game price to 4.99$ and the maximum sales will be -60%. The update should be there in a couple of weeks.

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.
